release_notes: Build 114 improves Website Sync missing recovery for quizzes moved from C: to the configured Z: archive.
Website project recovery now checks up to 2,000 Quiz History entries, matching the Website audit instead of only the most recent history subset.
Known archive-journal links are safely restored before the normal local project search runs, using the same History ID, database and archive ownership checks as the archive workflow.
Genuinely missing project folders, quiz.json files and question images now report their specific error instead of being grouped under a generic files unavailable message.
Existing Cloudflare quiz copies remain untouched by Sync missing; only absent website quizzes are uploaded.
Build 113 stable Needs You status and Build 112 performance-driven quiz category selection remain included unchanged.
